title: Leashable Collars (Unofficial NeoForge Port)
description: An unofficial port of the leashable collars mod by jlortiz0 onto NeoForge 1.21.4
body:
This is an unoffical partial recreation of the [Leashable Collars](https://modrinth.com/mod/leashable-collars) mod by [jlortiz0](https://modrinth.com/user/jlortiz0) onto NeoForge 1.21.4.

The mod adds:
A collar that can have multiple owners and is dyable, a leash to lead players that you own, and a clicker.

The mod uses the leash texture from [enjarai's](https://modrinth.com/user/enjarai) mod [Eternally Bound](https://modrinth.com/mod/eternally-bound).

If you are jlortiz0/enjarai and would like to contact me about the mod, the easiest way to reach me is on Discord @rainsxy_
